detail.longDescription: Gemma 4 E2B, E4B, 12B and a 26B-A4B fp8 build read by their label probabilities with vLLM on one TPU v6e chip, checked against the same read on an NVIDIA L4 and against Jev 1.13.0's published results. # gemma # googlecloud # machinelearning # llm # software # coding # development # engineering # inclusive # community Running a Jev-Style Decision Model on One TPU v6e: What Fits, What It Costs, and What Changes From a GPU
